name: Bloodfields: Camps
summary: The Muramite staging camps where legions gather, supplies are distributed, and warfront operations are coordinated.
description: The Bloodfields Camps serve as the primary staging area for Muramite forces. Barracks, supply tents, beast pens, and command pavilions fill the encampment. Legionnaires rotate between the Camps and the Front, while officers coordinate assaults and supply lines. Resistance infiltrators attempt sabotage, theft, and prisoner extraction. Discord energy occasionally warps the terrain, creating unstable pockets near the camp perimeter.
